I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and the select's appearance are unchecked.

It's the full screen at 1280px inside `#component`, in static HTML and CSS. It has the "Audit log" heading, the "Date range" select set to "Last 7 days", and the eight events in a table with Time, Person and Action columns.

- **Tokens inlined:** I copied only the tokens the page uses from `tokens.css` into the file, so it's self-contained.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so they fall back to the system font in the `--font-*` stacks.
- **Added column headers:** "Time", "Person" and "Action" aren't in your content. `DESIGN.md` asks for a header row on lists, so I added them. Say if you want them removed.
- **Left out:** No primary action button and no top navigation. You didn't list either, and `DESIGN.md` only calls for them when the screen has one.
